--- title: "pkginfo: Tools for Retrieving R Package Information" author: Aravind Hebbali description: "An experimental R package for retrieving R package information." date: 2019-07-05 categories: - packages tags: - pkginfo image: /img/github_pkginfo.png aliases: - /2019/07/05/introducing-pkginfo/ --- ![pkginfo](/img/github_pkginfo.png){width="100%"} ## Motivation There are several wonderful tools for retrieving information about R packages, some of which are listed below: - **[cranlogs](https://github.com/r-hub/cranlogs)**, **[dlstats](https://github.com/GuangchuangYu/dlstats)** and **[packageRank](https://github.com/lindbrook/packageRank)** for R package download stats - **[pkgsearch](https://github.com/r-hub/pkgsearch)** and **[packagefinder](https://github.com/jsugarelli/packagefinder/)** for searching CRAN R packages - **[crandb](https://github.com/r-hub/crandb)** provides API for programatically accessing meta-data - **[cchecks](https://github.com/ropenscilabs/cchecks)** for CRAN check results We have used some or all of these to track/monitor our own [R packages](https://pkgs.rsquaredacademy.com) available on CRAN. Over time, we wanted to have a single interface which would retrieve information from different places including: - check results from [CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/) - issues & pull requests from [GitHub](https://github.com/) - build status from [Travis](https://travis-ci.org/) and [Appveyor](https://ci.appveyor.com/) - code coverage from [Codecov](https://codecov.io/) - questions tagged with the package name in [Stack Overflow](https://stackoverflow.com/) And below is a demo of what we came up with... {{< video https://www.youtube.com/embed/g7Lcmgiyzmo >}} The above shiny app can be launched with: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} pkginfo::pkginfo_dashboard() ``` ::: ## Introduction [pkginfo](https://github.com/rsquaredacademy/pkginfo) will allow you to retrieve information from multiple places. The shiny app is especially useful if you are looking for information about multiple R packages. [pkginfo](https://github.com/rsquaredacademy/pkginfo) provides two APIs, one is object oriented, the other one is procedural, and in this post, we will show you how to use them. ## Installation You can install the development version from [GitHub](https://github.com/rsquaredacademy/pkginfo) with: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} devtools::install_github("rsquaredacademy/pkginfo") ``` :::
## Object Oriented API The object oriented API uses [R6](https://github.com/r-lib/R6) classes. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} library(pkginfo) ``` ::: ### GitHub #### Creating a new GitHubRepo object ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} myRepo <- GitHubRepo$new("olsrr", "rsquaredacademy") ``` ::: #### Stars, Forks & Issues `get_stats()` will report the number of stars, forks and open issues. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} myRepo$get_stats() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tibble: 1 × 3 stars issues forks 1 102 20 24 ``` ::: ::: #### Issues `get_issues()` will report the date, number, author and title of all the open issues. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} myRepo$get_issues() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tibble: 20 × 4 date number author title 1 2026-10-04 226 aravindhebbali "docs: cross-link Data Visualization with R… 2 2026-09-15 225 aravindhebbali "[Sprint 0.1] Golden textbook test suite, s… 3 2026-09-15 224 aravindhebbali "[P0-2] Information Criteria Mathematical R… 4 2026-04-15 222 aravindhebbali "Release olsrr 0.7.0" 5 2025-03-04 221 viqule11 "ols_regress() Outputting Incorrect MSE/RMS… 6 2024-10-29 215 LSantanaZA "olsrr 0.60 - olsrr::ols_step_all_possible … 7 2023-06-24 206 kaygmz "error while using olsrr function: " 8 2022-07-27 199 hirscht "ols_step_forward_p(...) problem using many… 9 2021-08-13 186 aravindhebbali "Error in stepwise backward selection " 10 2020-12-14 172 yayyb "Unable to output the result using function… 11 2020-12-05 170 comatrion "AICc metric" 12 2020-06-06 163 AminHP "Stepwise selection based on Adjusted R-Squ… 13 2020-05-05 162 linusjf "User must be able to specify different bes… 14 2020-05-04 161 linusjf "ggplot (or grob) object must be printed wh… 15 2020-05-04 160 linusjf "Methods returning data.frame of decision c… 16 2020-04-28 158 linusjf "Cannot coerce class ‘\"function\"’ to a da… 17 2019-12-10 146 sblanco74 "Hi @aravindhebbali" 18 2019-11-18 138 vasili111 "Linear mixed model support?" 19 2019-10-04 137 aravindhebbali "Automated report" 20 2018-09-21 92 cccfran "categorical variable" ``` ::: ::: #### Branches `get_branches()` will report the name of the branches. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} myRepo$get_branches() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tibble: 3 × 1 branches 1 develop 2 docs/link-viz-base 3 master ``` ::: ::: #### Build Status & Code Coverage The build status is reported from [Travis CI](https://travis-ci.org/) and [Appveyor](https://ci.appveyor.com/) while code coverage is reported from [Codecov](https://codecov.io/) ::: {.callout-note} Travis CI was shut down for open source projects in 2021 and Codecov no longer serves the endpoint this method expects, so the next two calls cannot be re-executed. The code is kept for reference; the outputs have been omitted rather than regenerated. ::: ##### Travis CI ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} myRepo$get_travis_status() ``` ::: ##### Codecov ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} myRepo$get_coverage() ``` :::

## Procedural API ### GitHub To use the procedural API for retrieving GitHub information, you need to provide the following inputs: - package/repo name - GitHUb user/organization name (optional) If you do not know the GitHub user/org name, leave it empty. [pkginfo](https://github.com/rsquaredacademy/pkginfo) will look for the user/org name in the **URLS** available on the CRAN page of the package. #### Stars, Forks & Issues ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} get_gh_stats("olsrr", "rsquaredacademy") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tibble: 1 × 3 stars issues forks 1 102 20 24 ``` ::: ::: #### Issues ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} get_gh_issues("olsrr", "rsquaredacademy") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tibble: 20 × 4 date number author title 1 2026-10-04 226 aravindhebbali "docs: cross-link Data Visualization with R… 2 2026-09-15 225 aravindhebbali "[Sprint 0.1] Golden textbook test suite, s… 3 2026-09-15 224 aravindhebbali "[P0-2] Information Criteria Mathematical R… 4 2026-04-15 222 aravindhebbali "Release olsrr 0.7.0" 5 2025-03-04 221 viqule11 "ols_regress() Outputting Incorrect MSE/RMS… 6 2024-10-29 215 LSantanaZA "olsrr 0.60 - olsrr::ols_step_all_possible … 7 2023-06-24 206 kaygmz "error while using olsrr function: " 8 2022-07-27 199 hirscht "ols_step_forward_p(...) problem using many… 9 2021-08-13 186 aravindhebbali "Error in stepwise backward selection " 10 2020-12-14 172 yayyb "Unable to output the result using function… 11 2020-12-05 170 comatrion "AICc metric" 12 2020-06-06 163 AminHP "Stepwise selection based on Adjusted R-Squ… 13 2020-05-05 162 linusjf "User must be able to specify different bes… 14 2020-05-04 161 linusjf "ggplot (or grob) object must be printed wh… 15 2020-05-04 160 linusjf "Methods returning data.frame of decision c… 16 2020-04-28 158 linusjf "Cannot coerce class ‘\"function\"’ to a da… 17 2019-12-10 146 sblanco74 "Hi @aravindhebbali" 18 2019-11-18 138 vasili111 "Linear mixed model support?" 19 2019-10-04 137 aravindhebbali "Automated report" 20 2018-09-21 92 cccfran "categorical variable" ``` ::: :::
### CRAN Check Results The CRAN check results is reported using the [cchecksapi](https://github.com/ropenscilabs/cchecksapi) API. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} get_pkg_cran_check_results("olsrr") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tibble: 13 × 3 os r status 1 linux-x86_64 patched OK 2 linux-x86_64 release OK 3 linux-x86_64-debian-clang devel OK 4 linux-x86_64-debian-gcc devel OK 5 linux-x86_64-fedora-clang devel OK 6 linux-x86_64-fedora-gcc devel OK 7 macos-arm64 release OK 8 macos-arm64 oldrel OK 9 macos-x86_64 release OK 10 macos-x86_64 oldrel OK 11 windows-x86_64 devel OK 12 windows-x86_64 release OK 13 windows-x86_64 oldrel OK ``` ::: ::: ### Build Status You can check the build status of a package from both [Travis CI](https://travis-ci.org/) and [Appveyor](https://ci.appveyor.com/). ::: {.callout-note} The Travis CI helper below refers to a service that no longer exists, so it is shown but not executed. ::: #### Travis CI ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} get_status_travis("olsrr", "rsquaredacademy") ``` ::: #### Appveyor ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} get_status_appveyor("olsrr", "rsquaredacademy") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` [1] "failed" ``` ::: ::: ### Code Coverage Report code coverage for the package from the coverage service [Codecov](https://codecov.io/). We hope to add coverage from [Coveralls](https://coveralls.io/) in the near future. ::: {.callout-note} The Codecov endpoint used by this helper no longer returns the JSON the package expects, so the call is shown but not executed. ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} get_code_coverage("olsrr", "rsquaredacademy") ``` ::: ### Stack Overflow Questions tagged with the package name will be displayed from [Stack Overflow](https://stackoverflow.com/). ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} get_so_questions("dplyr") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` # A tibble: 30 × 6 date title owner answered views link 1 2021-08-04 How to copy multiple data frames to a … mr_p… TRUE 424 http… 2 2022-10-28 Understanding `purrr::pmap` with a dat… Juli… TRUE 295 http… 3 2026-10-04 Avoid `zoo:na.fill(x, "extend&quo… rtur… TRUE 128 http… 4 2026-10-01 Changing the class of a column using d… drma… TRUE 150 http… 5 2022-11-24 Replacing values by cell index across … Seym… FALSE 153 http… 6 2019-09-05 R: Calculate percentage of activities … HCAI TRUE 70 http… 7 2026-09-23 Creating a function to find two values… Sabr… TRUE 290 http… 8 2026-09-18 st_sample() applied to sf lines not pl… Kail… TRUE 175 http… 9 2016-10-22 no applicable method for 'group_by… Neil FALSE 11214 http… 10 2026-09-01 dplyr::pick behaving differently than … Janu… TRUE 224 http… # ℹ 20 more rows ``` ::: ::: ## To Do.. In the near future, [pkginfo](https://github.com/rsquaredacademy/pkginfo) will retrieve information: - about packages that are available on GitHub/GitLab but not on CRAN - packages that are available on [GitLab](https://about.gitlab.com/) - about code coverage from [Coveralls](https://coveralls.io/) - about Twitter mentions We did not have any specific end user in mind while developing but believe it will be more useful to package developers/maintainers. Suggestions/feedbacks and pull requests are always welcome. If you see mistakes or want to suggest changes, please create an issue on the source repository or reach out to us at feedback@rsquaredacademy.com.
